title: Cut Susi 0.21.50: bump the engine version, re-record VC-203 evidence, hand the tagged build to release.yml
goal: Release main as 0.21.50. v0.21.48 (71633e121) and v0.21.49 (0fcf3e735) were tagged but never published: each tagged suite failed gmcp_requirements mastery on stale VC-203 evidence, because a susi-gmcp change (#1561, #1618) merged while the bump waited and core PR checks do not run gmcp_requirements. Bump the seven engine-version manifests, Cargo.lock, the README badge and the three ledgers (matching 4bf339c84), re-record VC-203 evidence on the bump branch (scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh, both phases) so the merged commit carries current evidence, and let the merge bot tag v0.21.50 and dispatch release.yml, which publishes the windows-x86_64 and linux-x86_64 binaries. Installed Windows production promotion is a separate, evidence-gated step and is not claimed by this cut.
